title: Seven-day network-inactive crate MAIL expiry
assumptions: Owner explicitly authorized forfeiting unclaimed MAIL after seven days of network inactivity. Before: no inactivity expiry. After: only MAIL, unchanged revision, max(network lastSeen, MAIL.updatedAt) at least 604800000 ms old, absent from a complete proxy-origin roster received at most 10000 ms ago.
Unknown, future or failed activity; missing, malformed, foreign or stale roster; an online player on any backend; DELIVERING/REVIEW; or uncertain storage always retain the entitlement.

One participant per distinct named entitlement unit. These are separate one-owner cohorts; the calculator does not sum different reward units. The observed cohort contains two eligible MAIL rights and one recent right that must remain.

Base/high describe eligibility of the observed one-time cohort, not an ongoing daily reward frequency. Each named entitlement has a one-unit network weekly ceiling in this assessment. Future unclaimed-mail rates are unknown.

The two eligible selections are case_weekly/ae_black_scrolls_4 and case_weekly/ae_randomizers_8; the recent case_weekly/weekly_gift_choice remains. Each has empty preparedReward and deliveryWitness. Exact inner item counts and any SELL value are unverified and are not inferred from identifiers.

No price, weight, bundle contents, key costs, roll count, refund, direct money payout or currency conversion changes. Expired IDs remain spent forever. SELL/AutoSell and the planned SELL-to-contract transition remain unchanged.

Conditional forfeiture removes a future item-claim liability. It creates no currency burn: no existing Vault, token, crystal or XP balance is touched. Indirect sale/redemption value is unknown and not added to the direct delta.

No price accumulation or full-set progression changes; low/base/high active play and earning rates are irrelevant to this one-time conditional liability removal. Exploit ceiling: at most each already-spent opening can expire once, with durable readback before compaction; no reroll, duplicate payout or ABORTED retry.

decision: Implement the owner-authorized seven-day offline-only MAIL expiry as honest EXPIRED, retaining durable JSON and compact spent identity. Do not expire uncertain or online records; do not report an expiry as a delivered reward.
post_delivery_check: Parent verifies activated version/hash, two eligible rights only when runtime evidence is still authoritative, recent/online right retained, no inventory/currency mutations, and lower retained heap. No live mutation performed by this source task.
